phase_1.title: Phase 1 · M24 SWS Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 7.62×51mm NATO primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 415 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 415 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 610 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 5-groove bore and accelerates to 790 m/s (3530 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Manual Bolt Cycle & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, manual bolt rotation disengages rigid locking lugs before rearward extraction and forward chambering.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 5-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the M24 SWS staged for its 15 RPM (Manual 90° Turn-Bolt) cadence.

zh.headline: 雷明顿 M24 SWS 狙击手武器系统：1988 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: M24 狙击手武器系统以雷明顿 700 长行程圆筒机匣为骨，创造性采用 5R 奇数斜边不锈钢浮置重枪管与 HS Precision 铝合金骨架凯夫拉复合枪托；预留长行程机匣使其后来顺畅升级为 .300 Win Mag 口径的 M2010 ESR。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：M24 SWS 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1988 年问世的 雷明顿 M24 SWS 狙击手武器系统 由美国雷明顿武器公司（Remington Arms）主导研制，定位为经典的军用栓动狙击武器系统。1988 年正式列装美国陆军的 M24 是美军首个以“完整系统（含瞄具、应急机械瞄、测距与维护箱）”而非单一枪械招标定型的狙击体系。
M24 狙击手武器系统以雷明顿 700 长行程圆筒机匣为骨，创造性采用 5R 奇数斜边不锈钢浮置重枪管与 HS Precision 铝合金骨架凯夫拉复合枪托；预留长行程机匣使其后来顺畅升级为 .300 Win Mag 口径的 M2010 ESR。 整件装备总长 1,092 mm（可调拉距凯夫拉复合材料托）、空重 5.4 kg，成为同期狙击步枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1988 年，美国雷明顿武器公司（Remington Arms）推出了划时代的雷明顿 M24 SWS 狙击手武器系统。1988 年正式列装美国陆军的 M24 是美军首个以“完整系统（含瞄具、应急机械瞄、测距与维护箱）”而非单一枪械招标定型的狙击体系。 它的核心设计聚焦于416R 不锈钢自由浮置重管采用 5R（5 条 65° 斜坡阳线）膛线，精度达 0.5 MOA 级，奠定了其在狙击步枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 雷明顿 M24 SWS 狙击手武器系统 的机械灵魂在于其「旋转后拉式栓动 · 雷明顿 700 长行程双突笋推弹入膛 + 5R 膛线」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，射手手动旋转枪机手柄使刚性闭锁突笋脱槽，向后抽抛并推进新弹入膛，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物精加工而成。雷明顿 700“三环包覆钢（枪机头、枪管尾、机匣环）”提供极高同轴度与耐压强度，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。雷明顿 M24 SWS 狙击手武器系统 采用旋转后拉式栓动 · 雷明顿 700 长行程双突笋推弹入膛 + 5R 膛线。在每个击发周期中，射手手动旋转枪机手柄使刚性闭锁突笋脱槽，向后抽抛并推进新弹入膛。借助硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物工艺与高强度配合，实现了雷明顿 700“三环包覆钢（枪机头、枪管尾、机匣环）”提供极高同轴度与耐压强度。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 7.62×51mm NATO 弹药规格与 610 mm 416R 不锈钢重管 · 5R 斜边膛线（1:286 mm 缠距），最高工作膛压约 415 MPa，可赋予弹头 790 m/s 的出膛初速与 3,530 J 动能，有效作用距离达 800 米。
内膛技术特点方面，标志性 5R 奇数斜边阳线（65° 坡角）显著减少铜垢堆积与弹头被甲切变。同时，刻意选用长行程机匣发射 7.62 NATO，为二十年后升级 .300 Win Mag 预埋扩展空间，令其在 15 发/分（手动 90° 旋转拉栓） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 610 毫米身管与 7.62×51mm NATO 口径，雷明顿 M24 SWS 狙击手武器系统 实现了每秒 790 米的初速与 800 米有效射程。标志性 5R 奇数斜边阳线（65° 坡角）显著减少铜垢堆积与弹头被甲切变，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 5 发容量的机匣内置固定盒式弹仓与 38 mm 膛轴设计，雷明顿 M24 SWS 狙击手武器系统 将单发后坐冲量控制在 10.5 N·s 水平。HS Precision 芳纶石墨复合枪托内置 CNC 铝床块，湿热环境下永不变形跑零。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-69）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 5 发容量的机匣内置固定盒式弹仓与出色的整体工效，HS Precision 芳纶石墨复合枪托内置 CNC 铝床块，湿热环境下永不变形跑零。欢迎在 BAY-69 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 雷明顿 M24 SWS 狙击手武器系统 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the M24 SWS
paragraphs: Introduced in 1988 by Remington Arms in United States, the Remington M24 SWS emerged as a defining Military Bolt-Action Sniper Weapon System. Adopted by the U.S. Army in 1988, the M24 was the first American sniper rifle procured as an integrated Sniper Weapon System complete with Leupold optics, iron backups, and field kit.

Built on a Remington 700 long-action cylindrical receiver with a free-floated 416R stainless 5R-rifled barrel and aluminum-bedded Kevlar stock, the M24 SWS delivered sub-MOA precision and later converted cleanly into the .300 Win Mag M2010 ESR. Measuring 1,092 mm (Adjustable-LOP Kevlar-Graphite Stock) at an unloaded weight of 5.4 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Sniper Rifle class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1988, Remington Arms of United States introduced the Remington M24 SWS. Adopted by the U.S. Army in 1988, the M24 was the first American sniper rifle procured as an integrated Sniper Weapon System complete with Leupold optics, iron backups, and field kit. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Free-floated 416R stainless barrel with 5R sloped-land rifling achieves repeatable sub-MOA groups — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Remington M24 SWS sits its Turn-Bolt Action · Remington 700 Long-Action Dual-Lug Push-Feed & 5R Canted-Land Bore. Throughout every firing cycle, manual bolt rotation disengages rigid locking lugs before rearward extraction and forward chambering, containing 415 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Remington 700 "three rings of steel" bolt-face enclosure maximizes lockup concentricity, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Remington M24 SWS relies on Turn-Bolt Action · Remington 700 Long-Action Dual-Lug Push-Feed & 5R Canted-Land Bore. During each cycle, manual bolt rotation disengages rigid locking lugs before rearward extraction and forward chambering. Machined from hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Remington 700 "three rings of steel" bolt-face enclosure maximizes lockup concentricity.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 7.62×51mm NATO with 610 mm 416R Stainless Heavy Barrel · 5R Canted-Land Rifling (1:286 mm), the Remington M24 SWS develops 790 m/s muzzle velocity and 3,530 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 800 meters.

Internally, Signature 5R odd-count 65°-sloped lands minimize copper fouling and jacket deformation for sub-MOA consistency. Combined with its 15 RPM (Manual 90° Turn-Bolt) tempo, Oversized long-action receiver intentionally future-proofed conversion to .300 Win Mag, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 7.62×51mm NATO through its 610 millimeter bore, the Remington M24 SWS achieves 790 meters per second and 800 meters of effective reach. Signature 5R odd-count 65°-sloped lands minimize copper fouling and jacket deformation for sub-MOA consistency.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 5-round internal fixed box magazine with a 38 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 10.5 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Aluminum-chassis Kevlar-graphite stock resists humidity-induced point-of-impact shift.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-69), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
